summary: Round 2 clears bar — six 4s, zero 3s. blueprint.curriculum_expectations.A8.2 now byte-matches input_row ('collect and record data to answer questions of interest, and display it in concrete graphs or picture graphs'). Duration 35 min (8/19/8) K-appropriate. Trap (double-count / one-to-one lapse) cites Sarama & Clements 2009 + CGI counting in rationale and action step 6. Three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: counts ahead of touching → point-then-say; B: loses count past 5 → chunk in 5s; C: counts but cannot record → COUNT-tally rhythm). Tally's quotable refrain 'Tally's rule: ONE touch, ONE tally!' chanted 3x at exit. NO-PAPER finger-tally path explicit in differentiation.for_movement_learners. STRATEGY COMPARE in action step 6 (two pairs share counts of same set, compare totals, find over/under-count). Worksheet's three parts each practise a named success criterion; Part 3 varies as transfer task (survey 6 classmates). Ship.
